variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian is rude at the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan makes coffins for the Chapel on the side, Mabry says business is bad.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome to the Drowned Lantern. You want a room or a drink? Make up your mind, I haven't got all day.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Welcome! Arms and armor, and coffins for the Chapel when there's call for them. What do you need?

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: A customer! Times are hard, stranger. Please, buy something. Anything!

variants.specifics: Thrumm: Bulgo of the Deep Mug inn (and coffins), Dask the armorer, Yselde of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bulgo
inn.text: Welcome to the Deep Mug, friend! Beds upstairs, coffins out back. Either way ya get a good long rest! Heh, heh, heh...

arms.speaker: Dask
arms.text: Welcome to Dask's Armory! The finest steel under the mountain. How can I help you?

magic.speaker: Yselde
magic.text: Don't touch the scrolls with those filthy hands. Buy something or get out.

variants.specifics: Tharn: Morla of the Green Lamp inn, Harrok the smith, Nimm the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Morla
inn.text: Welcome to the Green Lamp, stranger! I saved my best room just for you. It costs a little extra, of course!

arms.speaker: Harrok
arms.text: Welcome. Nobody's buying much these days. Folks are too scared to leave their huts. Take a look, anyway.

magic.speaker: Nimm
magic.text: Welcome to Nimm's! The finest potions in all the swamp! Well... the finest in Tharn, anyway.

variants.specifics: Durnath: Brumbo of the Black Boar inn, Hulgar of the castle armory, Zelpha the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Brumbo
inn.text: Welcome to the Black Boar! A bed's only 10 gold, and I throw in the fleas fer free! Har, har, har!

arms.speaker: Hulgar
arms.text: Welcome to the Armory of Castle Durnath. Arms and armor for the loyal subjects of Lord Tavrin.

magic.speaker: Zelpha
magic.text: Hmph. Don't touch anything. Buy something or leave.

variants.specifics: Tullin: Tam Rooke of the Blue Heron inn, Orlo the armorer, Sabeth the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Tam Rooke
inn.text: Welcome to the Blue Heron! Fresh fish and a warm bed, every night!

arms.speaker: Orlo
arms.text: This is Orlo's Lakeside Armory. Swords and shields of the finest quality. What is your business?

magic.speaker: Sabeth
magic.text: Oh my, you look half drowned! Come in, come in. I have just the potion for you.

variants.specifics: Quorran: Bodge keeps the inn, Brack the arms shop, Hulda the potion and scroll shop.

inn.speaker: Bodge
inn.text: What?! Can't you see I'm busy? Ugh. Fine. A bed or a drink?

arms.speaker: Brack
arms.text: Welcome to Brack's Arms and Armor, Official Supplier to the Academy Watch. How may I serve you?

magic.speaker: Hulda
magic.text: Come in, come in! I can tell by the jingle you've got gold to spend. Have a look around!

variants.specifics: Tor Vessa: Rudd of the Frozen Boot inn, Haskel the smith, Brunna who sells potions and makes coffins.

inn.speaker: Rudd
inn.text: Welcome to the Frozen Boot! Warm yer bones by the fire, lad. The ale's colder'n a dead Troll's toes!

arms.speaker: Haskel
arms.text: What? You want a blade, buy a blade. I don't have all day.

magic.speaker: Brunna
magic.text: Greetings, stranger. Potions and spell books are on the shelf. If you need a coffin, I make those too. Lots of folks do this winter.

variants.specifics: Kildrun: Mott of the Bellows inn, Brannoc the armorer, Imbra of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Mott
inn.text: Welcome to the Bellows! Best ale this side of the mountain!

arms.speaker: Brannoc
arms.text: Well, look at you! You've seen some fighting, I can tell. Come in and have a look around.

magic.speaker: Imbra
magic.text: Ah, a customer! My prices went up this morning. Don't ask me why. Heh, heh.

variants.specifics: Harrow Cross: Gilly keeps the Cartwheel Inn and makes coffins, Brask sells arms, Sabrine sells potions and does not like browsers.

inn.speaker: Gilly
inn.text: Welcome to the Cartwheel Inn! Beds are upstairs. I make coffins out back too, if things go bad for you.

arms.speaker: Brask
arms.text: Come in, come in! I hope you brought plenty of gold. Prices went up when the dead started walking. Heh, heh.

magic.speaker: Sabrine
magic.text: Hmmph. Don't touch the bottles unless you're buying.

variants.specifics: Vardo: Bessa keeps the inn, Krell the armory, Zenna the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Bessa
inn.text: Pay first, drink after. That's the rule in this house.

arms.speaker: Krell
arms.text: Welcome to Krell's Armory! Good steel at a fair price!

magic.speaker: Zenna
magic.text: Hmmm. You look like you've been in a fight or two. I have just the potions for you.
